result:
I fixed F-DG4-160 and swept the other "later release" strings. Every required check passed on the final tree, and the changes are left uncommitted for you to integrate.

**The F-DG4-160 fix (transformation edit page hint, EN and AR)**
- **English:** "Only the allowed next statuses are offered: draft → active; active → on hold; on hold → active. A transformation is closed from its Closure page, once the G6 (Sustain) business approval and the closure conditions are met."
- **Arabic:** "…يُغلَق التحوّل من صفحة «الإغلاق» الخاصة به، بعد اعتماد الأعمال للبوابة G6 (الاستدامة) واستيفاء شروط الإغلاق." This follows the Closure page's own wording.
- `transformations.test.tsx` now pins the exact sentence in both languages, and checks that the edit page shows it in both English (left-to-right) and Arabic (right-to-left).
- The journeys e2e test now checks the hint on the real stack, with a screenshot (`08a-edit-status-hint.png`) and an axe accessibility scan.
- Product behaviour is unchanged: the status list still never offers "closed".

**Sweep: three more strings corrected**

| String | Why it was wrong | New text says |
|---|---|---|
| `nav.plannedBody` (Playbook, Risks and Actions, Change and Adoption, BAU landing pages) | It said the area "is not available yet", but DG4 delivers screens under each of these areas (RAID, adoption plan, lessons, phase steps and so on) | Only the cross-portfolio view of the area is planned for a later release; its existing screens are listed under it in the navigation; the dashboards summarize your transformations |
| `nav.entry.portfolioPlanned` (partial-area pages such as Benefits and Finance) | It implied no cross-transformation view exists, but DG4 delivers the executive and Finance dashboards | Same idea: the cross-portfolio view is planned, and the dashboards already summarize |
| `nav.willContain` | The heading "What this area will contain" sat over contents DG4 already delivers | "What this area covers" / «ما يغطيه هذا القسم» |

All three are pinned in `app.test.tsx`: each of the four planned areas and one partial area is rendered in both languages, and the test checks that the sub-entries the text points to really are in the navigation. Both e2e specs check them too.

**Sweep: strings left unchanged, with reasons**
- **Never shown in DG4:**
  - `gates.notEnabled`, `gates.notEnabledBody` and the `gate_not_enabled` error: migrations 0026 and 0059 enable submission for all six gates, and no API code changes that setting.
  - `transformations.workspace.laterStage`: nothing in the web app uses this key.
  - `nav.p4.beingBuiltBody`: the list of placeholder routes that would show it is empty.
- **True for DG4:**
  - `admin.plannedSections`: every section it names (methodology, forms, workflows, automation, branding) is DG5 scope.
  - `access__scope_type_reserved`: the scope types beyond organization, business unit and transformation come in DG6.

The full table with file and line references is in the handback. No string needed more than a text change, so the D-137 escalation condition is not met.

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate --historical --stage DG3` | Exit 0 at the start and at the end |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier, `pnpm openapi:lint` | All exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | Exit 0 both times, same counts: 1589, 1358, and 259 passed with 2 skipped |
| e2e on the real stack: `journeys.spec.ts` and `p3-seams.spec.ts` | 24 passed. Each of chromium-en and chromium-ar passed journeys 9 and p3-seams 3, with 0 serious or critical axe issues |

- **Three runs, not two:** `pnpm test` runs three Vitest invocations rather than the two the assignment mentions. The 2 skips are existing conditional skips in `packages/shared/src/formula/fuzz.test.ts`, which this change doesn't touch.
- **Integration suite:** I didn't run it, because the change touches no API, contract or schema.
- **Re-run on the final text:** I re-ran every check after one late edit. I dropped "open one transformation at a time" from the planned-area text, because Lesson search works across transformations. The logs are all from the final text.

**Other notes**
- The worktree contains untracked dotfiles I didn't create (`.bashrc`, `.vscode`, `CLAUDE.local.md` and others). Don't integrate them.
- Per D-137, the release-auditor verifies the closure of F-DG4-160 in round 10. I haven't closed my own finding.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG4/`:
- T-DG4-FE-R11-frontend-ux-engineer.md
- T-DG4-FE-R11-evidence/ (logs, plus EN and AR screenshots under `screenshots/en/` and `screenshots/ar/`)
